recognize_zh: 高倍下大型組織球的細胞核與細胞質均呈強棕色陽性（S100 典型的核加質染色），細胞質中有完整的藍色淋巴球位於透亮空隙內，清楚呈現 emperipolesis，是 Rosai-Dorfman 病的經典免疫染色影像。
features: Large histiocytes with strong nuclear and cytoplasmic brown staining (S100-type pattern)
Intact unstained lymphocytes and plasma cells within histiocyte cytoplasm, some in clear halos (emperipolesis)
Histiocyte nuclei round and vesicular where visible
Background small lymphocytes and endothelial cells negative
No cytologic atypia in the positive cells
describe_en: High-power immunohistochemical stain shows large histiocytes with strong nuclear and cytoplasmic positivity. Within their cytoplasm are intact, unstained lymphocytes and plasma cells, several lying within clear halos, demonstrating emperipolesis. The surrounding small lymphocytes are negative, and the positive cells show no significant atypia. The nuclear-plus-cytoplasmic pattern is characteristic of S100, although the antibody is not labeled. Findings are consistent with Rosai-Dorfman disease; CD1a negativity and OCT2 or cyclin D1 positivity further support the diagnosis.

ddx.vs: LCH is S100 positive but CD1a and langerin positive, with grooved nuclei and eosinophils, and lacks emperipolesis.
HLH macrophages phagocytose and digest red cells, platelets and nucleated cells and are S100 negative.
ECD histiocytes are foamy, S100 negative or weak, CD1a negative and typically harbor BRAF V600E with sclerosing bone lesions.
